name: Airport Auntie Anne's Soft Pretzel (Plain, Dry, NO Butter, Light Salt)
whyItWorks: Enriched wheat dough baked fresh in the terminal. When ordered 'dry' without the customary ladle of melted margarine butter, it is low in fat, dairy-free, and provides easily digestible carbohydrates.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Original Pretzel, but please make it DRY—NO butter brush, light salt only.' (They will pull a fresh one before the butter bath).
